integrity: Direct count and symbolic pole computations were checked with an included standalone verifier; the analytic proof, not a computation certificate, establishes the general theorem. No independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The exact period and oscillatory leading coefficient are proved only for three cyclic blocks of equal integer size a>=2. The full rational numerator and cycles of length at least five are not classified. Historical priority requires independent literature review.
title: Exact period and leading parity oscillation for the three-block cyclic polytope
